nvitk.restoration
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.restoration

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Image restoration / denoising utilities.

   Exposes:

   * :func:`bilateral` — backend-aware bilateral filter (skimage CPU / CUDA GPU).
   * :func:`n4_bias_field_correction` — ANTsPy N4 bias-field correction.
   * :func:`mri_super_resolution` — ANTsPyNet MRI super-resolution.

.. py:function:: bilateral(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, sigma_spatial: Optional[float] = None, sigma_color: Optional[float] = None, kernel_radius: Optional[int] = None, do_3d: bool = False, axis: int = 0, backend: Literal['auto', 'numpy', 'cupy'] = 'auto') -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Edge-preserving bilateral filter.

   :param image: 2-D or 3-D input (:class:`Image` or raw array).
   :param sigma_spatial: Bilateral parameters; auto-estimated from *image* when omitted
                         (see :func:`estimate_bilateral_parameters`).
   :param sigma_color: Bilateral parameters; auto-estimated from *image* when omitted
                       (see :func:`estimate_bilateral_parameters`).
   :param kernel_radius: Half-width of the spatial kernel. Defaults to ``ceil(2 * sigma_spatial)``.
   :param do_3d: If True and the input is 3-D, run a native 3-D filter. If False, apply
                 a 2-D filter slice-by-slice along *axis* (scikit-image semantics).
   :param axis: Slicing axis for stack-by-stack 3-D filtering (ignored when ``do_3d``).
   :param backend: Force ``"numpy"`` (skimage) or ``"cupy"`` (CUDA kernels); ``"auto"``
                   (default) follows :func:`get_current_backend`.

   :returns: Same wrapping as *image* and same backend as the input (when
             ``backend='auto'``) or the requested backend otherwise.
   :rtype: Image | ndarray


.. py:function:: bilateral_2d(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, sigma_spatial: Optional[float] = None, sigma_color: Optional[float] = None, kernel_radius: Optional[int] = None, backend: Literal['auto', 'numpy', 'cupy'] = 'auto') -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   2-D bilateral filter (fails on 3-D inputs; use :func:`bilateral` instead).


.. py:function:: bilateral_3d(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, sigma_spatial: Optional[float] = None, sigma_color: Optional[float] = None, kernel_radius: Optional[int] = None, backend: Literal['auto', 'numpy', 'cupy'] = 'auto') -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   True 3-D bilateral filter. Falls back to slice-by-slice on the CPU backend.


.. py:function:: estimate_bilateral_parameters(image: Any, *, spatial_pct: float = 0.02, spatial_min: float = 1.0, spatial_max: float = 5.0) -> Tuple[float, float]

   Return ``(sigma_spatial, sigma_color)`` for *image*.

   ``sigma_spatial`` is a fraction of the shortest spatial dimension (clamped
   to ``[spatial_min, spatial_max]``). ``sigma_color`` defaults to
   :func:`numpy.std` (legacy scikit-image convention).

   Accepts :class:`Image`, NumPy or CuPy arrays.


.. py:data:: MRI_SR_EXPANSION_FACTORS
   :type:  tuple[tuple[int, int, int], Ellipsis]
   :value: ((1, 1, 2), (1, 1, 3), (1, 1, 4), (1, 1, 6), (2, 2, 2), (2, 2, 4))


.. py:data:: MRI_SR_FEATURES
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('vgg', 'grader')


.. py:function:: mri_super_resolution(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, expansion_factor: Sequence[float | int] | list[float] | tuple[float, Ellipsis] = (1, 1, 2), feature: str = 'vgg', verbose: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray

   ANTsPyNet deep back-projection MRI super-resolution.

   :param image: Input MRI volume.
   :param expansion_factor: Per-axis integer upsampling factors. Supported: ``1,1,2``, ``1,1,3``,
                            ``1,1,4``, ``1,1,6``, ``2,2,2``, ``2,2,4``. Must be ints (floats like
                            ``1.0`` are coerced only when exactly integral).
   :param feature: Feature backbone: ``vgg`` or ``grader`` (``1,1,6`` + ``grader`` has no weights).


.. py:function:: n4_bias_field_correction(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, mask: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray | None = None, *, shrink_factor: int = 4, spline_param: float | int | None = None, rescale_intensities: bool = False, convergence_iters: tuple[int, Ellipsis] | list[int] | None = None, convergence_tol: float = 1e-07, return_bias_field: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray | tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]

   Correct intensity inhomogeneity with ANTs N4.

   :param image: Input intensity volume (typically MRI).
   :param mask: Optional soft-tissue / brain mask restricting the bias estimate.
   :param shrink_factor: Downsampling factor for the bias estimate (ANTs default 4).
   :param spline_param: B-spline fitting distance (voxels); ``None`` uses ANTs default.
   :param rescale_intensities: Rescale intensities into ``[0, 1]`` before correction.
   :param return_bias_field: When true, also return the estimated bias field volume.

   :returns: * *corrected* -- Bias-corrected intensity array (NumPy).
             * *(corrected, bias_field)* -- When ``return_bias_field`` is true.
